The test gap for a nonidentity Table75 Matrix is distinct and is drafted in shading_pattern_matrix_spec_audit.rs.

Its pages have link annotations only in the inspected annotation inventory. Table74's #294 changes the caption to say stream and #428 qualifies tile order as implementation-dependent.
